The software product and domain **taxgpt.com** (TaxGPT) is directly provided and operated by **TaxGPT Inc.**

### Evidence & Citations:
* **Operating Company / Developer Listing:** The official app store publisher listing identifies the developer as **TaxGPT Inc.** (dev@taxgpt.com, 1151 Mission St, San Francisco, CA).
* **Provider / Corporate Statement:** Business and industry records confirm that *"TaxGPT is owned and operated by TaxGPT Inc."* (founded by Kashif Ali and Isabella Maceda-Ali) to provide tax automation software through **taxgpt.com**. Furthermore, B2B software listings state: *"TaxGPT Inc. is a pioneering company... The company's platform, accessible through https://www.taxgpt.com/, offers user-friendly tax solutions that optimize accuracy and ensure compliance with the latest tax laws and regulations."*
